resources.string: Astrovia is an independent project based on the Aladin Sky Atlas, developed by the Centre de Données astronomiques de Strasbourg (CDS).

Astrovia is NOT affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by the CDS or the Aladin project. \"Aladin\", \"CDS\", \"Simbad\" and \"VizieR\" belong to their respective owners and are only mentioned to credit the original work and data.
Made with the help of AI
This port / adaptation to Android was created with the help of artificial intelligence tools. It may contain mistakes: please report any problem you find.
Free, no ads and no tracking. Licensed under the GNU General Public License v3 (GPL-3.0). The source code is publicly available.

Astrovia has no accounts and collects no personal data. To show images and catalogs it connects to public astronomical services (HiPS servers, Simbad and VizieR at CDS); the coordinates and names you search are sent to those servers. This research has made use of the SIMBAD database and the VizieR catalogue access tool, operated at CDS, Strasbourg, France. The Archives search also queries the ESA archives (ESA Sky TAP, Gaia, HST), the NASA Exoplanet Archive and IMCCE SkyBoT; the coordinates of the field you look at are sent to them. Their data terms and citations apply.
